risks.title: Material not specified in title block
risks.rationale: Material field is blank, so the part cannot be made or quoted.
risks.mitigation: Populate the material field before release.

risks.title: Critical bore Ø25 has no tolerance
risks.rationale: ASME Y14.5 requires all dimensions to carry a tolerance; a fit-critical bore without one is undefined.
risks.mitigation: Add a tolerance/fit class (e.g. H7) to the bore.

risks.title: Mixed units: length in inches, others in mm
risks.rationale: Title block says MM but the length is dimensioned in inches; high risk of mis-manufacture.
risks.mitigation: Convert all dimensions to a single unit system.
